Snippet view only - full text is behind De Gruyter paywall / Harvard Widener print copy PL3311.Y5 P45 2011; needs library access to quote the table with its caption and page.
new_statements.rule_in_words: Thopho is a lexical-tone Ngwi language: Pelkey's first-hand survey data tabulate five Thopho tone categories /55/, /33/, /21/, /24/, /52/ as reflexes of Proto-Ngwi tone classes *1 *2 *3 *H *L (e.g. *1 > 33 67%, *2 > 21 50%, *3 > 33 50%, *H > 33 69%, *L > 21 59%); nothing anywhere in the book on word stress/accent (book-wide stress vocabulary = 0 hits per the earlier 33-query probe).
new_statements.exceptions: Table 6.2 lists multiple reflexes per proto-class (e.g. *2 > 21/55/52), i.e. splits/irregular correspondences; 24 and 52 are minor categories (24: 13%/0/10%/0/0). Whether 24 and 52 are contrastive tonemes or sandhi/allotonic values in Thopho is not recoverable from snippets (in sister lect Muji-PJZ 52 is a marginal toneme that also arises by sandhi).
new_statements.identity_note: Thopho = Pelkey's datapoint Thopho-XZC (Xinzhai, Zhema, Zhetu Twp, Guangnan) = ISO ytp created on Pelkey's 2007 request; the snippet rows are labelled 'Thopho' explicitly, alongside Moji, Pholo, Azha, Azhe, Axi, Laghuu, Core Muji. | Appendix 1 row 69 identifies the column: 'Southeastern | Muji | Thopho | Pelkey 2011 | analysis | B | Yunnan | XZC (Thopho): Guangnan County, Zhetu, Xinzhai 广南县者兔乡新寨 | Guangnan | Zhetu | Xinzhai | 24.09911695 | 104.7437693' = Pelkey's Thopho-XZC datapoint = ISO ytp = thop1236 (ITEM coords 24.15/104.9). Data are second-hand: Yang tabulates Pelkey 2011's (De Gruyter book, login-walled) Thopho tone-class reflexes; type 'B' = analysis only, no wordlist.

new_statements.relation_note: Tone only: gives Thopho's tone reflex value for c. 70 Proto-Ngwi etyma rows (values 33, 21, 55, 24, 52, marginal 13) and the Muji-cluster rising-tone correspondences (Thopho 24 < *2 after voiced/glottalised obstruents, where Core Muji has 13). Nothing on stress. Open (CC-BY-4. it independently corroborates A's snippet reading of Pelkey 2011 ch. 6 (five categories 55 33 21 24 52).
new_statements.rule_in_words: Thopho is recorded as a lexical-tone Ngwi language: its syllable tones, as reflexes of Proto-Ngwi categories, are *1 > 33 (55 after certain cluster initials, 21~33 after plain voiceless stops), *2 > 21 after voiced/voiceless plain initials but 24 after (prenasalised/preglottalised) voiced obstruents and 55 after preglottalised/s-prefixed initials (52 in 'sky'), *3 > 33, checked *H > 21 (33/55 in some environments), checked *L > 21 after continuants / 33 after prefixed obstruents - i.e. surface tone values 55, 33, 21, 24, 52 (13 marginal). The database has no field for and says nothing about word stress or accent.
